name: Fractals minimum distance
summary: This EA trades based on Bill Williams' Fractal indicator, entering positions when price breaks above or below fractal levels. It incorporates a minimum distance filter to avoid trading when fractals are too close to current price, reducing false signals. The EA is a systematic breakout strategy that uses fractal structure as dynamic support and resistance levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的分形指标进行交易，当价格突破分形水平时进场。它加入了最小距离过滤器，避免在分形距离当前价格过近时交易，从而减少假信号。这是一个系统性的突破策略，利用分形结构作为动态支撑和阻力位。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯分形指标识别关键支撑阻力位。入场条件为：当价格向上突破上方分形时做多，向下突破下方分形时做空，同时要求突破价格与分形之间的距离不小于设定的最小距离参数，以过滤掉过于接近的无效突破信号。出场条件主要依赖止盈止损设置，当价格达到预设的TP或SL水平时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺少账户权益比例计算，风险控制相对基础。整体策略逻辑清晰，利用分形作为自然的市场结构突破点，但缺少对市场趋势方向的过滤，可能在震荡行情中产生较多假突破亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy uses Bill Williams' Fractal indicator to identify key support and resistance levels in the market. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when price breaks above an upper fractal, and a sell signal when price breaks below a lower fractal, provided the distance between the breakout price and the fractal meets the minimum distance threshold to filter out weak signals. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels set at trade entry. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic scaling based on account equity or volatility. Money management is relatively basic, lacking risk-per-trade percentage calculations or equity-based lot sizing. The overall logic is clean and leverages fractals as natural market structure breakout points, but the absence of a trend direction filter means it can suffer from false breakouts during ranging markets.

parameters.name: MinDistance
parameters.description: 分形与当前价格之间的最小距离过滤阈值
parameters.description_en: Minimum distance filter between fractal and current price

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分不同EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 分形指标是经过验证的市场结构识别工具，能有效标记关键支撑阻力位
最小距离过滤器是一个实用的创新，可以减少假突破带来的亏损
策略逻辑简单清晰，参数少，易于理解和调优
突破分形入场具有天然的趋势跟随属性，在趋势行情中表现良好
pros_en: Fractals are a proven market structure identification tool that effectively marks key support and resistance levels
The minimum distance filter is a practical innovation that reduces losses from false breakouts
The strategy logic is simple and clear with few parameters, making it easy to understand and optimize
Entering on fractal breakouts has a natural trend-following property, performing well in trending markets
cons: 缺少趋势方向过滤，震荡行情中容易产生连续假突破亏损
固定手数仓位管理无法根据市场波动和账户风险动态调整
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等动态波动指标
缺少持仓管理逻辑，如移动止损或部分平仓机制
cons_en: Lacks a trend direction filter, prone to consecutive false breakout losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot position sizing cannot dynamically adjust based on market volatility and account risk
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed pip values without considering dynamic volatility indicators like ATR
Lacks position management logic such as trailing stops or partial close mechanisms
improvements: 增加趋势方向过滤器（如MA或ADX），仅在趋势方向一致时才允许突破交易
使用ATR动态计算止损止盈，并基于账户风险比例自动调整仓位大小
加入新K线检查和持仓检查机制，避免重复开仓和过度交易
improvements_en: Add a trend direction filter (e.g., MA or ADX) to only allow breakouts aligned with the prevailing trend
Use ATR for dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation, and auto-adjust lot size based on account risk percentage
Implement new bar check and position check mechanisms to prevent duplicate entries and overtrading

risk_points: 缺少趋势方向过滤可能在震荡市中频繁亏损
固定手数和固定止损未考虑市场波动性变化
没有新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter may cause frequent losses in ranging markets
Fixed lots and fixed SL/TP do not account for changing market volatility
No new bar check may lead to duplicate position opening on the same signal
